questions.question: What happens to domestic consumption according to the speaker?
questions.answer: It is diverted to foreign goods.
questions.explanation: The primary excerpt Q0000 states that more of the domestic consumption is diverted to foreign goods.

evidence.quote:

 is diverted to foreign goods.
